about: Test conditions for solid-material tests that NASA's experiment tables leave out, taken from NASA's own reports and sensor logs in PSI. Hand-checked by workstream A against the downloaded files (scripts/fetch_psi_docs.py, scripts/extract_docs.py; see docs/PSI_DOCUMENTS.md). build_web_data.py applies these to tests.json; validate_data.py checks them. data/ is never edited.
